# Search phone contacts for remaining senders by email and determine if any are labeled roommate/coworker
allowed_rels=set(['roommate','coworker'])
remaining_ids = [1896,2745,2746,5261,3769,1114,2741,1895,4641,4633,2743,1113,3771,3768,4640,2740]
# map id->pending info from earlier 'pending' list
rem = {p['payment_request_id']: p for p in pending if p['payment_request_id'] in remaining_ids}

phone_token = globals()['phone_token']

matches_info=[]
for pid in remaining_ids:
    pr=rem[pid]
    sender=pr['sender']
    sname=(sender.get('name') or '').strip()
    semail=(sender.get('email') or '').strip()
    if not semail and not sname:
        continue
    # search contacts with query=sender email if available else name
    q = semail if semail else sname
    i=0
    found=[]
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=q, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        found.extend(page)
        i+=1
    # Determine if any found contacts have roommate/coworker relationship
    qualifies=[]
    for c in found:
        rels=c.get('relationships') or []
        if any(r in allowed_rels for r in rels):
            qualifies.append({'contact_id':c.get('contact_id'), 'name':(c.get('first_name','')+' '+c.get('last_name','')).strip(), 'email':c.get('email'), 'relationships':rels})
    matches_info.append({'pid':pid,'sender_name':sname,'sender_email':semail,'found_count':len(found),'qualifies_count':len(qualifies),'qualifies':qualifies})

print('checked', len(matches_info))
for info in matches_info:
    print(info)

remaining_pending_ids = [1896,2745,2746,5261,3769,1114,2741,1895,4641,4633,2743,1113,3771,3768,4640,2740]
remaining = [p for p in pending if p['payment_request_id'] in remaining_pending_ids]
print('remaining count', len(remaining))

allowed_rels = {'roommate','coworker'}

def normalize(s):
    return (s or '').strip().lower().replace('.','').replace("'",'')

for pr in remaining:
    pid = pr['payment_request_id']
    sender_name = pr['sender'].get('name','')
    sender_email = pr['sender'].get('email','')
    print('\nPID', pid, 'sender_name', sender_name, 'sender_email', sender_email)
    # Build exact-match contacts from roommate/coworker by email and by name
    # Search all contacts with relationship filter roommates/coworkers and check exact matches
    email_norm = normalize(sender_email)
    name_norm = normalize(sender_name)
    exact_email_matches=[]
    exact_name_matches=[]
    # iterate over cached contacts list 'contacts' from earlier (roommate/coworker only)
    # contacts variable currently includes only roommate/coworker contacts from earlier code.
    for c in contacts:
        cemail = normalize(c.get('email'))
        cf = (c.get('first_name','') or '').strip()
        cl = (c.get('last_name','') or '').strip()
        full = normalize((cf+' '+cl).strip())
        if email_norm and cemail==email_norm:
            exact_email_matches.append((c.get('contact_id'), cf, cl, cemail, c.get('relationships')))
        if name_norm and full==name_norm:
            exact_name_matches.append((c.get('contact_id'), cf, cl, cemail, c.get('relationships')))
    print('exact_email_matches', exact_email_matches)
    print('exact_fullname_matches', exact_name_matches)

    # Additionally, do a broader search_contacts query by sender name and email, no relationship filter.
    # Only treat a returned contact as matching if its email equals sender email or full name equals sender name.
    q_candidates=[sender_email, sender_name]
    broad_matches=[]
    for q in q_candidates:
        if not q: 
            continue
        i=0
        while True:
            page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=q, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
            if not page:
                break
            for c in page:
                cemail=normalize(c.get('email'))
                cf=(c.get('first_name','') or '').strip(); cl=(c.get('last_name','') or '').strip()
                full=normalize((cf+' '+cl).strip())
                if (email_norm and cemail==email_norm) or (name_norm and full==name_norm):
                    broad_matches.append((c.get('contact_id'), cf, cl, cemail, c.get('relationships')))
            i+=1
    # de-dup
    dedup=[]
    seen=set()
    for bm in broad_matches:
        key=(bm[0],)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            dedup.append(bm)
    print('broad_exact_matches', dedup)

    # Determine if any matching contact has roommate/coworker relationship
    matching_contacts = {bm[0]: bm for bm in dedup}
    qualifies=[]
    for cid,b in matching_contacts.items():
        rels=b[4] if len(b)>4 else []
        if any(r in allowed_rels for r in (rels or [])):
            qualifies.append(b)
    print('qualifies_by_relationship', qualifies)

# Re-check remaining pending and match against roommate/coworker contacts by exact email or name parts

# Re-fetch roommate/coworker contacts (all pages)
allowed_relationships = ['roommate','coworker']
contacts=[]
for rel in allowed_relationships:
    i=0
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=rel, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        contacts.extend(page)
        i+=1

print('roommate_coworker_contacts_count', len(contacts))

# build lookup
norm = lambda s: (s or '').strip().lower()
contact_emails=set([norm(c.get('email')) for c in contacts if c.get('email')])
contact_fullnames=set([norm((c.get('first_name','')+' '+c.get('last_name','')).strip()) for c in contacts])
contact_first=set([norm(c.get('first_name')) for c in contacts if c.get('first_name')])
contact_last=set([norm(c.get('last_name')) for c in contacts if c.get('last_name')])

# fetch all pending
pending=[]
i=0
while True:
    res=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status='pending', page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    pending.extend(res)
    i+=1

print('remaining_pending_total', len(pending))

matched=[]
for pr in pending:
    sender=pr.get('sender',{}) or {}
    s_email = norm(sender.get('email'))
    s_name = norm(sender.get('name'))
    parts = [p for p in s_name.replace(',',' ').split() if p]
    by_email = s_email in contact_emails if s_email else False
    full = s_name in contact_fullnames if s_name else False
    by_name_parts = any((p in contact_first) or (p in contact_last) for p in parts) if parts else False
    if by_email or full or by_name_parts:
        matched.append((pr['payment_request_id'], sender.get('name'), s_email, pr.get('amount'), {'by_email':by_email,'full':full,'by_name_parts':by_name_parts}))

print('matched_pending_against_roommate_or_coworker', len(matched))
for item in matched:
    print(item)
